title: Terry McLaurin believed to have season-ending knee injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Terry McLaurin believed to have season-ending knee injury
sources.description: Commanders wide receiver Terry McLaurin had to be carted off the field with an air cast on his left knee on Monday night and the image didn't do much to conjure up hopes of a quick return to the field this season.
